## A town under pressure

Lakeside has grown fast. The number of cross-border workers commuting out each day rose from about 18,000 in 2015 to 38,000 in 2023, with the steepest climb on the French side.

Housing has not kept pace. Average monthly rent is now highest in the North district at 1,450 euros, well above the 1,200 euros in the South and 1,050 in the East.

The deputy mayor said the council was 'aware of residents' frustration' but declined to give a timeline.
